verdict: Revenue is holding but purchase momentum slipped this week — being addressed now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $5,740.37 in revenue on $1,485.36 in spend, a 3.86 return on ad spend — a solid baseline, but the most recent week showed purchases down 28.57% and return on ad spend slipping 8.76% compared to the week prior. The primary campaign has been carrying a disproportionate share of spend, and with purchase volume trending toward zero in the last few days, creative fatigue is the most likely driver. Ad creative is being refreshed this week to reset performance, and campaign structure is being reviewed to reduce reliance on a single ad set. October's planned scaling work remains on track for month-end, and the goal for next week is to stabilize the purchase rate before that expansion begins.
